title: WearOS App and Blucon not working correctly
body:
With the No 2nd nightly my LG W100 WearOS watch stopped working as a collector. It collects values from the blucon for a short period of time, maybe 10 minutes. Restarting the collector service helps for another 10 minutes.
There are no issues with the Oct 30th nightly.

Since there were some changes in the code regarding libre/blucon was there also a change in the WearOS app code?

comments.body:
sorry to hear this but modifications done can't explain this.

we need find root cause.

are you willing to help?

best is to send logs, can you activate wear logs and ask to send it to me?

are you sure you updated wear app too? you need to delete and reinstall.

can you tell me which value is used for BT watchdog?

Thank you for the quick reply. Problem solved!
I don't know wether it was the app or my watch. But with the nightly from Nov 15th it's working just as before.

good to know.
could you please close the issue then?
